Which Way?

Which Way?

⭐ 0

Rules

  • Move: put your finger on the dark arrow and drag it along the streets. (Computer: drag with the mouse or use the arrow keys.)
  • Left and right always mean your left and right. Look where the arrow points!
  • Turnings: count only the streets on the side you need. “The second turning on the left” = the second street that goes to the left.

1 · Follow the way

  1. Read the directions – or press 🔊 and listen.
  2. Walk the way with the arrow. Then press I'm here!
  3. Write the name of the place.
  4. ⭐ for the right way (first try) and ⭐ for the right name. After two wrong tries you see the way.

2 · Stop!

  1. Walk only to the STOP: stop right after you turn into the new street.
  2. Press STOP. Then answer the question: What is on your left / right? Which street are you in?
  3. ⭐ for every right stop and ⭐ for every right answer (first try).

3 · Give directions

  1. A tourist asks you the way. Write the directions in English.
  2. Press Go! The tourist walks exactly what you write.
  3. Finish with: It is on your left / right.
  4. ⭐ when the tourist finds the place on the first try.
